question: Compare three explicitly implemented candidates against the same market and frozen DC on the same 227 K League 1 2025 prices/results
features: 2024 and 2025 strictly monthly-out-of-time DC forecasts; 2024 meta-training warmup; meta-training day <= evaluation month start minus 7 days; min100 past complete priced rows; no current/future target outcomes in prediction

cohorts.base_score_history: official 2023-2025; 2025 used only when earlier than the monthly cutoff

market_goal_inversion: same Shin 1X2 vector -> independent Poisson/Skellam home/draw probabilities; bounded log rates [.01,10], fixed initial rates; least_squares xtol/ftol/gtol1e-12 max_nfev200; stop if max probability residual>1e-6; outcomes not used

models.market: frozen src.devig.shin on each archived complete 3-way price vector
models.dc: unchanged src.research_kleague_dc from #487, 180day half-life/L2=10/rho bounds unchanged

bayes_market_goal.label: Market-informed hierarchical residual goal model, Laplace approximation; adapted from Egidi, NOT exact paper MCMC reproduction
bayes_market_goal.priors: raw team residuals N(0,1/10), intercept_delta N(0,1), home_delta N(0,1/4), w~Beta(2,2); theta=logit(w) prior includes Jacobian: -2log(w)-2log(1-w)
bayes_market_goal.likelihood: sum past OOF joint goal negative log-likelihood, no new recency weights
bayes_market_goal.bounds: intercept/home[-2,2], raw team residuals[-2,2], theta[-6,6]; stop if MAP is within1e-5 of boundary
bayes_market_goal.inference: L-BFGS-B analytic gradient max2000 ftol1e-11 gtol1e-7; Hessian from central finite difference of analytic gradient, symmetrize; require positive eigenvalues>1e-8; normal Laplace posterior;128 deterministic antithetic draws seed20261101 per fit; prediction integrates draws via Skellam CDF
bayes_market_goal.unknown_team: zero-centered independent prior residual draws with variance1/10; seed based only on stable fixture identity, not outcome
bayes_market_goal.limits: Conditioned on frozen DC offsets and market goal inversion; no full posterior over the source DC; no player/tipster features

moe_two_expert.tipster_expert: unavailable, NOT replaced with fake votes
moe_two_expert.scaling: fit mean/std on past meta-training only, zero std->1
moe_two_expert.fit: one zero initialization L-BFGS-B max2000; intercept[-8,8], others[-5,5]; no model/feature/threshold search

fl_glm.formula: p_i = odds_i^(-beta) / sum_j odds_j^(-beta), Algorithm6 of Goto et al 2026 arXiv2604.17194v1
fl_glm.fit: one beta, past-only sum categorical negative loglikelihood, bounded[-5,10], no ridge, stop if optimum is at bound; analytic derivative and scalar root/convex solver
fl_glm.ranking: beta>0 preserves lowest-odds argmax; report changed picks even when probabilities/calibration change; beta=0 exact ties abstain

choices: argmax each three-way vector; exact1e-12 ties abstain, no odds/EV/underdog filters; no tuning of choices
metrics: paired observed-week bootstrap10000 seed20261101, descriptive only
uncertainty: Report all three comparisons, no winner significance from best observed result; 2025 reused, price receipt unverified, test227<300 formal minimum
actions: No operating model, wallet, scheduling, DB, deployment, betting or email changes. Keep monthly50000KRW limit. Code/data/results draft PR only.
